name: Utility Judgments Benchmark
description: A benchmarking procedure and dataset designed to evaluate large language models' ability to assess the utility of passages in supporting open-domain question answering. It includes candidate passages with different characteristics to study utility evaluation capabilities.
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark from the open-domain QA literature for studying passage utility judgments, with limited but growing research use.
notes: Includes a k-sampling, listwise approach to reduce input sequence dependency.
